# SpringConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringConstraint")`

A spring between two attachments: it pulls them together when they are further apart than `FreeLength` and pushes them apart when they are closer, harder the further they are from it. A suspension, a bouncy bridge, a door that closes by itself.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

| `Damping` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The force against each metre a second its length is changing, in newton-seconds a metre. None and it bounces for ever; a lot and it creeps. |
| `FreeLength` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The length at which it neither pulls nor pushes, in metres. |

| `MinLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The shortest it can be, in metres. |
